description: The LWJGL backend behind the toolkit's SPIs: windows and drawing through GLFW and OpenGL, with OpenGL ES through ANGLE where a Windows or macOS machine has no usable OpenGL; text through HarfBuzz and stb, SVG through lunasvg, sound through OpenAL; the system's dialogs, clipboard, drag and drop, tray, menu bar and printing, and the screen-reader bridges of Windows, macOS and Linux. Brings the natives of all six desktop platforms.
